name: radial_series_nfw_mis_gamma_v1

profile.family: NFW centred (Wright & Brainerd 2000) + gamma-kernel miscentred, exactly the src/models/nfw_dsigma_mis.hh conventions
profile.miscentering_kernel: gamma: P(R_mis | s) = (R_mis / s^2) exp(-R_mis / s), s = x_mis r_s
profile.amplitude: DSigma = A_sample * A0(y) * u; A0(y) = 2 e^y delta_c rho_crit * 1e-12 [Msun/(h pc^2)]; A_sample = 1 (centred) or rho_mult = Omega_m (miscentred), per sample
profile.coordinates: x = R e^-y, x_mis = r_mis e^-y, y = ln r_s(M)

contents.U{ell}_mis: (1/ell!) (1-L)^ell u_mis on (lnx, lnxm) axes, L = d/dlnx + d/dlnxm; array layout [ix, ixm]
contents.U1: retained for validation only; mu_1 vanishes by construction in the population series

axes.note: lnxm domain is reduced vs the source table (x_mis <= 20; production usage is x_mis <~ 2); evaluators clamp at the edges like Interp2D::clamp

numerics.sigma_off_quadrature: split GL 64+64, phi0=0.1, cubic squeeze; rel err <= ~6e-11
numerics.derivatives: 9-point central stencils along the exact (ln x, ln v) diagonal of e^s u
numerics.gamma_average: composite Simpson over the uniform ln v grid (matrix product); O(h^3) local error at the offset = radius crease, analytic below-grid tail

source_tables.role: cross-check only (U_0 fidelity); the noisy source table is NOT differentiated

interpolation: cubic splines on the stored axes are adequate; see validate_radial_series.py for measured interpolation + truncation tolerances
